channel.title: Qn_
channel.description: Rootless & roothide ports of useful tweaks, maintained by Qn

item.title: CCCalc 2.2.0
item.description:
• Rebuilt for rootful, rootless and roothide; Qn added to the credits.
  • No functional changes since 2.1.0.

item.title: DateLyrics 3.0.7
item.description: • Fixed Music crashing on iOS 16 when lyric timings or the playback position were invalid (NaN), e.g. while the queue reloads.

item.title: PleaseKeepLPM 1.0.1
item.description: • Fixed SpringBoard crashing when PleaseKeepLPM turned Low Power Mode back on.

item.title: SafariBlocker 1.3.5
item.description:
• Tabs you open yourself (e.g. SafariPicker's "Open in Private/Normal Mode") are no longer blocked; web pop-ups are still checked.
  • New Source Code section in settings.

item.title: SafariPicker 1.1.0
item.description:
• New "Source Code" button in settings.
  • New settings icon.

item.title: AutoPickUp 1.0.1
item.description:
• New: Answer with Volume Buttons. Press volume up or down to answer a ringing call instead of silencing it, for every app, even if its Auto Answer is off. Useful when the touchscreen doesn't work.
  • Speaker option now also applies to calls answered with the volume buttons.
  • Answer delay range is now 0–30 seconds (default 10).
  • Code cleanup.

item.title: PassBy 1.9.4
item.description:
• The unlock toast now also shows "PassBy: Magic passcode" every time you unlock with the magic passcode (setting renamed to "Show unlock toast").
  • Magic passcode unlocks are confirmed against the real lock state, since the unlock can finish asynchronously.

item.title: TapTapSlumber 0.0.7
item.description:
• Roothide build, source reconstructed from TapTapSlumber 0.0.3 by iGerman.
  • Double-tap empty space on the Home Screen, or the Lock Screen (including the passcode page), to lock the device.
  • New: Ignore Taps on Keypad, so typing a passcode quickly (e.g. "11") won't lock the device. Applies immediately; changing Home Screen / Lock Screen needs a respring.

item.title: TrueLink 0.0.1
item.description:
• Initial release, inspired by CleanCopy by b4db1r3.
  • Resolves short links (Google /goto?url=, Reddit /s/, amzn.to) to the real destination without opening the page.
  • Unwraps redirects (google.com/url?q=, Google Ads, Facebook l.php, LinkedIn).
  • Strips tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, si…) and share junk from Google, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, X, Reddit, LinkedIn and Spotify.
  • Shortens Amazon links to /dp/<ASIN>.
  • Works system-wide, including links inside copied text. If resolving a short link fails or takes over 4 s, the original link is copied.

item.title: FlicksForAll 0.2.2
item.description:
• Re-tuned Flick Sensitivity presets: they are now evenly spaced, and the lowest setting no longer makes flicks nearly impossible to trigger.
  • Settings: icons on each section, clearer descriptions (all settings below the test text field take effect immediately), copyright footer.

item.title: LSNowPlayingRepeat 1.3.0
item.description:
• iOS 16 support: on iOS 16.0–17.0.x the Repeat button replaces the audio output button, and long-press opens the output picker.
  • iOS 17.1+ unchanged: replaces Favorite, long-press toggles Favorite.

item.title: SlideCutPlus 1.0.2
item.description:
• Initial release: a rewrite of SlideCut for iOS 15+ (replaces SlideCut).
  • Touch the space key, slide to a letter and release to trigger a shortcut: X/C/V cut/copy/paste, A select all, Z/Y undo/redo, H J K L arrows, N/M previous/next word, S select word, Q/P start/end of line, B/E start/end of document, D translate, Delete removes the previous word.
  • Better Vietnamese Telex support: the letter no longer reaches the input method, so shortcuts never add diacritics to the current word.
  • Space+N moves to right after the previous word; Space+V adds a trailing space after pasting.

item.title: BetterTelex 0.2.1
item.description:
• Experimental iOS 14 support (untested on real devices; falls back to stock keyboard behaviour if it can't read the composition state).
  • Rootless and rootful builds available alongside roothide.

item.title: BadgeSync 1.2.2
item.description: • Axon compatibility.

item.title: CalculatorHistory 1.3
item.description:
• New tap and long-press interactions on history entries.
  • Localizations.
  • Separators are hidden for empty rows.

item.title: CCDNDTimer 1.3.1
item.description:
• Default timer is now 60 minutes.
  • Code cleanup, roothide build.

item.title: ChatGBeFree 1.0.0
item.description:
• Initial release.
  • Bypasses the "This version of ChatGPT has been sunset" screen on older iOS versions by spoofing the app version.

item.title: DeleteForeverXS 1.2.6
item.description: Support iOS 17 (Photos and Camera): permanently delete photos without leaving them in Recently Deleted. Roothide build.

item.title: DePuke 1.0.1
item.description:
• New Control Center module (via CCSupport) to toggle motion cues on the fly.
  • New settings pane with respring and reset buttons.

item.title: EmoZoom 1.0.2
item.description:
• Emojis in the variants popup are no longer resized.
  • Fixed vertical and horizontal spacing being swapped.
  • Long emojis no longer get truncated.
